# Machine Learning Lab

This repository documents the implementation and application of machine learning algorithms through hands-on projects. Each algorithm is organized into its own folder and includes one or more projects that demonstrate the complete machine learning workflow, including data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis, model training, evaluation, and prediction.

## Topics

### Linear Regression

* Canada Per Capita Income Prediction
* Hiring Salary Prediction

### Logistic Regression

*Projects coming soon.*

## Technologies

* Python
* Pandas
* NumPy
* Matplotlib
* Scikit-learn
* Jupyter Notebook

## Repository Structure

Each algorithm contains one or more independent projects, and every project includes its own README with a detailed explanation of the dataset, preprocessing steps, model implementation, and results.
